features.description: WorldCover 10m agricultural land-cover percentage in source vicinity; strongly influences agricultural burning vs wildfire discrimination.
WorldCover 10m dense tree/forest canopy coverage; key indicator for wildfire and forest fire classification.
Composite score derived from OpenStreetMap industrial infrastructure (refineries, chemical plants, steel works, mines, power stations).
Geodesic distance to closest mapped industrial or infrastructure asset in OSM.
Measure of multi-week continuous thermal recurrence; differentiates ongoing operational flares from transient open-field fires.
Total discrete calendar days with detected FIRMS thermal hotspots across the 90-day window.
Density of verified industrial, mining, and energy generation points within 5km radius.
Count of active extraction sites and mineral processing facilities within 5km.
Average thermal energy output across all detections measured in Megawatts by VIIRS.
Highest single-pass thermal radiance recorded during observation span.
Mean 3.75µm mid-infrared brightness temperature from VIIRS I-band sensor.
Cumulative count of individual satellite overpass hotspot alerts for this thermal cluster.
Fraction of thermal detections occurring during nighttime passes (characteristic of 24/7 continuous industrial processes).
Calendar days elapsed between earliest and latest recorded satellite thermal triggers.
WorldCover 10m grassland / shrubland percentage for open brushfire and rangeland discrimination.

transparency_disclosure: Features influencing the prototype Random Forest classification. These metrics represent relative feature importance across prototype decision boundaries and are presented for operational interpretability, not statistical causality.
